/* ---------------- terrain ---------------- */
function pointInPoly(px,py,poly){
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0,j=poly.length-1;i<poly.length;j=i++){
    const xi=poly[i][0],yi=poly[i][1],xj=poly[j][0],yj=poly[j][1];
    if(((yi>py)!==(yj>py))&&(px<(xj-xi)*(py-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi))inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

function earthlineLngLatToGrid(lng,lat){
  const lat0=M.centerLat||0,lng0=M.centerLng||0;
  const dxM=(lng-lng0)*(111320*Math.max(0.05,Math.cos(lat0*Math.PI/180)));
  const dyM=(lat0-lat)*111320;
  return [GW/2+dxM/Math.max(0.001,M.cellM||1),GH/2+dyM/Math.max(0.001,M.cellM||1)];
}

}

}

function buildTerrainProcedural(){
  const L=M.loc,s=M.seed%100000;
  const a=L.trendDeg*Math.PI/180;
  const tx=Math.cos(a),ty=Math.sin(a);
  const trendPerCell=L.trendSlope/100*M.cellM;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    let e=(x*tx+y*ty)*trendPerCell;
    e+=fbm(x*0.018,y*0.018,s,5)*L.relief*L.rough;
    e+=fbm(x*0.06,y*0.06,s+9,4)*L.relief*0.28*L.rough;
    e+=Math.sin(x*0.045+s%7)*Math.cos(y*0.05+s%5)*L.relief*0.18;
    M.h[idx(x,y)]=e;
  }
  M.satCanvas=null;
}
function lonLatToTile(lon,lat,z){
  const n=Math.pow(2,z);
  const x=(lon+180)/360*n;
  const latR=lat*Math.PI/180;
  const y=(1-Math.log(Math.tan(latR)+1/Math.cos(latR))/Math.PI)/2*n;
  return[x,y];
}
function loadImg(url){
  if(EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.has(url)){
    const cached=EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.get(url);
    EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.delete(url);
    EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.set(url,cached);
    return Promise.resolve(cached);
  }
  if(EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.has(url))return EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.get(url);
  const promise=new Promise((res,rej)=>{
    const im=new Image();
    im.crossOrigin="anonymous";
    let done=false;
    const to=setTimeout(()=>{if(!done){done=true;rej(new Error("tile timeout"));}},4500);
    im.onload=()=>{
      if(done)return;
      done=true;clearTimeout(to);
      EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.set(url,im);
      while(EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.size>EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_MAX_16293){
        const oldest=EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.keys().next().value;
        EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.delete(oldest);
      }
      res(im);
    };
    im.onerror=()=>{if(!done){done=true;clearTimeout(to);rej(new Error("tile load failed"));}};
    im.src=url;
  }).finally(()=>EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.delete(url));
  EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.set(url,promise);
  return promise;
}

async function fetchRealTerrain(lat,lng,myGen=M.searchGen){

  // zoom (for example 5.35 for Colorado) produced failed/partial tile grids.
  const satZ=Math.round(clamp(M.viewZoom,3,20));
  const demZ=Math.min(satZ,15);
  // Analysis grid is capped at z17 so the hydrology window never shrinks below a
  // usable property size (~250m). Imagery still renders at the true zoom (satZ),
  // but the flow/swale engine always has enough ground to produce real corridors.
  const analysisZ=Math.min(satZ,17);
  const mppA=mppAt(analysisZ,lat);
  const mppS=mppAt(satZ,lat), mppD=mppAt(demZ,lat);
  const requestedCellM=Number(M.requestedCellM||0);
  M.cellM=(requestedCellM>0&&Number.isFinite(requestedCellM))?requestedCellM:5*mppA;
  // BUILD-CHECK-15760: cell size is fitted to the selected ground area so a grid cell
  // never forces the prescription farther apart than the approved 25 ft maximum.
  const grab=async(z,tmpl)=>{
    const plan=earthlinePropertyTilePlan16453(z,lat,lng,M.cellM),ps=[];
    for(const [tx,ty] of plan.tiles)ps.push(loadImg(tmpl.replace("{z}",z).replace("{x}",tx).replace("{y}",ty)).catch(()=>null));
    const imgs=await Promise.all(ps);
    if(imgs.every(im=>!im))throw new Error("all tiles failed");
    const c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=512*plan.widthTiles;c.height=512*plan.heightTiles;
    const g=c.getContext("2d");let k=0;
    for(let row=0;row<plan.heightTiles;row++)for(let col=0;col<plan.widthTiles;col++){
      const im=imgs[k++];if(im)g.drawImage(im,col*512,row*512);
    }
    return {c,px0:(plan.tf[0]-plan.x0)*512,py0:(plan.tf[1]-plan.y0)*512,widthTiles:plan.widthTiles,heightTiles:plan.heightTiles,tileCount:plan.count};
  };
  const demT="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.terrain-rgb/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.pngraw?access_token="+MAPBOX_TOKEN;
  const satT="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.satellite/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.jpg90?access_token="+MAPBOX_TOKEN;
  // BUILD-CHECK-15672: the property preview already loaded satellite imagery. During
  // analysis fetch only the DEM unless imagery is genuinely absent, cutting the live
  // analysis request count roughly in half.
  const dem=await grab(demZ,demT);
  const sat=earthlineMap?null:(M.satCanvas?null:await grab(satZ,satT));
  if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))throw new Error("STALE_SEARCH");

  const demW=dem.c.width,demH=dem.c.height;

      const dxM=(gx-GW/2)*M.cellM, dyM=(gy-GH/2)*M.cellM;

      const py=clamp(Math.round(dem.py0+dyM/mppD),0,demH-1);
      const k=(py*demW+px)*4;

    }
    if((gy&7)===7){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"dem");}
  }

  for(let gy=0;gy<GH;gy++){

      for(let oy=-1;oy<=1;oy++)for(let ox=-1;ox<=1;ox++){
        const nx=clamp(gx+ox,0,GW-1),ny=clamp(gy+oy,0,GH-1);
        sm+=raw[idx(nx,ny)];c2++;
      }

    }

function buildRegionalTerrain(){
  // Fast state/region view: do not download hundreds of high-res parcel tiles.
  // Build a smooth planning-grade terrain canvas sized to the searched bbox plus context.
  const L=M.loc, bb=L&&L.bbox;
  if(!bb){buildTerrainProceduralWrap();return;}
  const latC=(bb[1]+bb[3])/2, lngC=(bb[0]+bb[2])/2;
  M.centerLat=latC; M.centerLng=lngC;
  const wM=Math.abs(bb[2]-bb[0])*111320*Math.cos(latC*Math.PI/180);
  const hM=Math.abs(bb[3]-bb[1])*111320;
  M.cellM=Math.max(wM/GW,hM/GH)*1.55; // whole state + visible surrounding-state edges
  const seed=M.seed%100000;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const nx=x/GW, ny=y/GH;
    // Colorado-like regional relief: west highlands, plains east, broad basins.
    const west=Math.max(0,1-nx);
    const ridge=Math.exp(-Math.pow((nx-0.23)/0.12,2))*(0.75+0.25*Math.sin(ny*18));
    const basin=Math.exp(-Math.pow((ny-0.62)/0.10,2))*0.25;
    const broad=fbm(nx*3.0,ny*3.0,seed+30,4)*0.28;
    const fine=fbm(nx*10.0,ny*10.0,seed+77,3)*0.08;
    M.h[idx(x,y)]=(west*0.65+ridge*0.75-basin+broad+fine)*900;
  }
  M.satCanvas=null;
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: regional mode uses one lightweight 3x3 satellite mosaic only.
// It does not download Terrain-RGB, decode a statewide DEM, or run parcel hydrology.
async function fetchRegionalSatellite(myGen=M.searchGen){
  buildRegionalTerrain();
  if(!MB_ON()||!M.loc||!M.loc.bbox)return true;
  const z=Math.round(clamp(M.viewZoom||5,3,8));
  const lat=M.centerLat,lng=M.centerLng;
  const tf=lonLatToTile(lng,lat,z);
  const cx=Math.floor(tf[0]),cy=Math.floor(tf[1]);
  const nMax=Math.pow(2,z)-1,rad=1,span=3;
  const tmpl="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.satellite/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.jpg90?access_token="+MAPBOX_TOKEN;
  const jobs=[];
  for(let dy=-rad;dy<=rad;dy++)for(let dx=-rad;dx<=rad;dx++){
    const tx=clamp(cx+dx,0,nMax),ty=clamp(cy+dy,0,nMax);
    const url=tmpl.replace("{z}",z).replace("{x}",tx).replace("{y}",ty);
    jobs.push(loadImg(url).catch(()=>null));
  }
  const imgs=await Promise.all(jobs);
  if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  if(imgs.every(im=>!im))return true; // procedural regional fallback remains usable
  const mosaic=document.createElement("canvas");mosaic.width=512*span;mosaic.height=512*span;
  const mg=mosaic.getContext("2d");let k=0;
  for(let row=0;row<span;row++)for(let col=0;col<span;col++){
    const im=imgs[k++];if(im)mg.drawImage(im,col*512,row*512);
  }
  const px0=(tf[0]-(cx-rad))*512,py0=(tf[1]-(cy-rad))*512;
  const mpp=mppAt(z,lat);
  const wPx=GW*M.cellM/mpp,hPx=GH*M.cellM/mpp;
  const satOut=document.createElement("canvas");satOut.width=840;satOut.height=584;
  satOut.getContext("2d").drawImage(mosaic,px0-wPx/2,py0-hPx/2,wPx,hPx,0,0,840,584);
  M.satCanvas=satOut;
  return true;
}

/* ---------------- terrain ---------------- */
function pointInPoly(px,py,poly){
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0,j=poly.length-1;i<poly.length;j=i++){
    const xi=poly[i][0],yi=poly[i][1],xj=poly[j][0],yj=poly[j][1];
    if(((yi>py)!==(yj>py))&&(px<(xj-xi)*(py-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi))inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}

}

function buildTerrainProcedural(){
  const L=M.loc,s=M.seed%100000;
  const a=L.trendDeg*Math.PI/180;
  const tx=Math.cos(a),ty=Math.sin(a);
  const trendPerCell=L.trendSlope/100*M.cellM;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    let e=(x*tx+y*ty)*trendPerCell;
    e+=fbm(x*0.018,y*0.018,s,5)*L.relief*L.rough;
    e+=fbm(x*0.06,y*0.06,s+9,4)*L.relief*0.28*L.rough;
    e+=Math.sin(x*0.045+s%7)*Math.cos(y*0.05+s%5)*L.relief*0.18;
    M.h[idx(x,y)]=e;
  }
  M.satCanvas=null;
}
function lonLatToTile(lon,lat,z){
  const n=Math.pow(2,z);
  const x=(lon+180)/360*n;
  const latR=lat*Math.PI/180;
  const y=(1-Math.log(Math.tan(latR)+1/Math.cos(latR))/Math.PI)/2*n;
  return[x,y];
}
function loadImg(url){
  if(EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.has(url)){
    const cached=EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.get(url);
    EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.delete(url);
    EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.set(url,cached);
    return Promise.resolve(cached);
  }
  if(EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.has(url))return EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.get(url);
  const promise=new Promise((res,rej)=>{
    const im=new Image();
    im.crossOrigin="anonymous";
    let done=false;
    const to=setTimeout(()=>{if(!done){done=true;rej(new Error("tile timeout"));}},4500);
    im.onload=()=>{
      if(done)return;
      done=true;clearTimeout(to);
      EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.set(url,im);
      while(EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.size>EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_MAX_16293){
        const oldest=EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.keys().next().value;
        EARTHLINE_TILE_CACHE_16293.delete(oldest);
      }
      res(im);
    };
    im.onerror=()=>{if(!done){done=true;clearTimeout(to);rej(new Error("tile load failed"));}};
    im.src=url;
  }).finally(()=>EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.delete(url));
  EARTHLINE_TILE_INFLIGHT.set(url,promise);
  return promise;
}

function zoneOffset(loc,zone){
  const k=loc.zones.indexOf(zone);
  if(k<=0)return[0,0];
  return [[0.25,0],[0,0.25],[-0.25,0]][k-1]||[0,0];
}
async function fetchRealTerrain(lat,lng,myGen=M.searchGen){
  // Mapbox raster tile URLs require integer zoom levels. A fractional regional
  // zoom (for example 5.35 for Colorado) produced failed/partial tile grids.
  const satZ=Math.round(clamp(M.viewZoom,3,20));
  const demZ=Math.min(satZ,15);
  // Analysis grid is capped at z17 so the hydrology window never shrinks below a
  // usable property size (~250m). Imagery still renders at the true zoom (satZ),
  // but the flow/swale engine always has enough ground to produce real corridors.
  const analysisZ=Math.min(satZ,17);
  const mppA=mppAt(analysisZ,lat);
  const mppS=mppAt(satZ,lat), mppD=mppAt(demZ,lat);
  const requestedCellM=Number(M.requestedCellM||0);
  M.cellM=(requestedCellM>0&&Number.isFinite(requestedCellM))?requestedCellM:5*mppA;
  // BUILD-CHECK-15760: cell size is fitted to the selected ground area so a grid cell
  // never forces the prescription farther apart than the approved 25 ft maximum.
  const grab=async(z,tmpl)=>{
    const plan=earthlinePropertyTilePlan16453(z,lat,lng,M.cellM),ps=[];
    for(const [tx,ty] of plan.tiles)ps.push(loadImg(tmpl.replace("{z}",z).replace("{x}",tx).replace("{y}",ty)).catch(()=>null));
    const imgs=await Promise.all(ps);
    if(imgs.every(im=>!im))throw new Error("all tiles failed");
    const c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=512*plan.widthTiles;c.height=512*plan.heightTiles;
    const g=c.getContext("2d");let k=0;
    for(let row=0;row<plan.heightTiles;row++)for(let col=0;col<plan.widthTiles;col++){
      const im=imgs[k++];if(im)g.drawImage(im,col*512,row*512);
    }
    return {c,px0:(plan.tf[0]-plan.x0)*512,py0:(plan.tf[1]-plan.y0)*512,widthTiles:plan.widthTiles,heightTiles:plan.heightTiles,tileCount:plan.count};
  };
  const demT="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.terrain-rgb/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.pngraw?access_token="+MAPBOX_TOKEN;
  const satT="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.satellite/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.jpg90?access_token="+MAPBOX_TOKEN;
  // BUILD-CHECK-15672: the property preview already loaded satellite imagery. During
  // analysis fetch only the DEM unless imagery is genuinely absent, cutting the live
  // analysis request count roughly in half.
  const dem=await grab(demZ,demT);
  const sat=earthlineMap?null:(M.satCanvas?null:await grab(satZ,satT));
  if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))throw new Error("STALE_SEARCH");
  earthlineProgress("dem");
  const demW=dem.c.width,demH=dem.c.height;
  const demD=dem.c.getContext("2d").getImageData(0,0,demW,demH).data;
  const raw=new Float32Array(N);
  for(let gy=0;gy<GH;gy++){
    for(let gx=0;gx<GW;gx++){
      const dxM=(gx-GW/2)*M.cellM, dyM=(gy-GH/2)*M.cellM;
      const px=clamp(Math.round(dem.px0+dxM/mppD),0,demW-1);
      const py=clamp(Math.round(dem.py0+dyM/mppD),0,demH-1);
      const k=(py*demW+px)*4;
      raw[idx(gx,gy)]=-10000+(demD[k]*65536+demD[k+1]*256+demD[k+2])*0.1;
    }
    if((gy&7)===7){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"dem");}
  }
  let mean=0;
  for(let gy=0;gy<GH;gy++){
    for(let gx=0;gx<GW;gx++){
      let sm=0,c2=0;
      for(let oy=-1;oy<=1;oy++)for(let ox=-1;ox<=1;ox++){
        const nx=clamp(gx+ox,0,GW-1),ny=clamp(gy+oy,0,GH-1);
        sm+=raw[idx(nx,ny)];c2++;
      }
      const v=sm/c2;
      M.h[idx(gx,gy)]=v;mean+=v;
    }
    if((gy&7)===7){earthlineAssertActive15686(myGen);await earthlineCoopYield15686(myGen,"dem");}
  }
  mean/=N;
  M.loc.elevM=Math.round(mean);
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++)M.h[i]-=mean;
  if(sat){
    const wPx=GW*M.cellM/mppS, hPx=GH*M.cellM/mppS;
    const satOut=document.createElement("canvas");satOut.width=840;satOut.height=584;
    satOut.getContext("2d").drawImage(sat.c,sat.px0-wPx/2,sat.py0-hPx/2,wPx,hPx,0,0,840,584);
    if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))throw new Error("STALE_SEARCH");
    M.satCanvas=satOut;
  }
}
function buildRegionalTerrain(){
  // Fast state/region view: do not download hundreds of high-res parcel tiles.
  // Build a smooth planning-grade terrain canvas sized to the searched bbox plus context.
  const L=M.loc, bb=L&&L.bbox;
  if(!bb){buildTerrainProceduralWrap();return;}
  const latC=(bb[1]+bb[3])/2, lngC=(bb[0]+bb[2])/2;
  M.centerLat=latC; M.centerLng=lngC;
  const wM=Math.abs(bb[2]-bb[0])*111320*Math.cos(latC*Math.PI/180);
  const hM=Math.abs(bb[3]-bb[1])*111320;
  M.cellM=Math.max(wM/GW,hM/GH)*1.55; // whole state + visible surrounding-state edges
  const seed=M.seed%100000;
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const nx=x/GW, ny=y/GH;
    // Colorado-like regional relief: west highlands, plains east, broad basins.
    const west=Math.max(0,1-nx);
    const ridge=Math.exp(-Math.pow((nx-0.23)/0.12,2))*(0.75+0.25*Math.sin(ny*18));
    const basin=Math.exp(-Math.pow((ny-0.62)/0.10,2))*0.25;
    const broad=fbm(nx*3.0,ny*3.0,seed+30,4)*0.28;
    const fine=fbm(nx*10.0,ny*10.0,seed+77,3)*0.08;
    M.h[idx(x,y)]=(west*0.65+ridge*0.75-basin+broad+fine)*900;
  }
  M.satCanvas=null;
}

// BUILD-CHECK-15672: regional mode uses one lightweight 3x3 satellite mosaic only.
// It does not download Terrain-RGB, decode a statewide DEM, or run parcel hydrology.
async function fetchRegionalSatellite(myGen=M.searchGen){
  buildRegionalTerrain();
  if(!MB_ON()||!M.loc||!M.loc.bbox)return true;
  const z=Math.round(clamp(M.viewZoom||5,3,8));
  const lat=M.centerLat,lng=M.centerLng;
  const tf=lonLatToTile(lng,lat,z);
  const cx=Math.floor(tf[0]),cy=Math.floor(tf[1]);
  const nMax=Math.pow(2,z)-1,rad=1,span=3;
  const tmpl="https://api.mapbox.com/v4/mapbox.satellite/{z}/{x}/{y}@2x.jpg90?access_token="+MAPBOX_TOKEN;
  const jobs=[];
  for(let dy=-rad;dy<=rad;dy++)for(let dx=-rad;dx<=rad;dx++){
    const tx=clamp(cx+dx,0,nMax),ty=clamp(cy+dy,0,nMax);
    const url=tmpl.replace("{z}",z).replace("{x}",tx).replace("{y}",ty);
    jobs.push(loadImg(url).catch(()=>null));
  }
  const imgs=await Promise.all(jobs);
  if(earthlineIsStale(myGen))return false;
  if(imgs.every(im=>!im))return true; // procedural regional fallback remains usable
  const mosaic=document.createElement("canvas");mosaic.width=512*span;mosaic.height=512*span;
  const mg=mosaic.getContext("2d");let k=0;
  for(let row=0;row<span;row++)for(let col=0;col<span;col++){
    const im=imgs[k++];if(im)mg.drawImage(im,col*512,row*512);
  }
  const px0=(tf[0]-(cx-rad))*512,py0=(tf[1]-(cy-rad))*512;
  const mpp=mppAt(z,lat);
  const wPx=GW*M.cellM/mpp,hPx=GH*M.cellM/mpp;
  const satOut=document.createElement("canvas");satOut.width=840;satOut.height=584;
  satOut.getContext("2d").drawImage(mosaic,px0-wPx/2,py0-hPx/2,wPx,hPx,0,0,840,584);
  M.satCanvas=satOut;
  return true;
}

  function finitePoint(p){return Array.isArray(p)&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[0]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[1]));}
  /* EARTHLINE 16318 — exact point-in-ring acceleration. The original crossing
     predicate is preserved byte-for-byte below; this index only eliminates ring
     segments whose latitude range cannot possibly participate in the test. */
  const ringIndexCache16318=new WeakMap();
  const ringIndexStats16318={ringsBuilt:0,segmentsIndexed:0,pointTests:0,candidateSegments:0};
  function ringIndex16318(ring){
    if(!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return null;
    const cached=ringIndexCache16318.get(ring);if(cached)return cached;
    let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;
    const segments=[];
    for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
      const a=ring[j],b=ring[i];if(!finitePoint(a)||!finitePoint(b))continue;
      const x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
      minX=Math.min(minX,x1,x2);maxX=Math.max(maxX,x1,x2);
      minY=Math.min(minY,y1,y2);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y1,y2);
      segments.push({a,b,ymin:Math.min(y1,y2),ymax:Math.max(y1,y2)});
    }
    if(!segments.length)return null;
    const bucketCount=Math.max(32,Math.min(512,Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(segments.length)*2)));
    const span=Math.max(1e-12,maxY-minY),buckets=Array.from({length:bucketCount},()=>[]);
    const bucketFor=y=>Math.max(0,Math.min(bucketCount-1,Math.floor(((Number(y)-minY)/span)*bucketCount)));
    for(const seg of segments){
      const lo=bucketFor(seg.ymin),hi=bucketFor(seg.ymax);
      for(let k=lo;k<=hi;k++)buckets[k].push(seg);
    }
    const meta={minX,minY,maxX,maxY,span,bucketCount,buckets,bucketFor,segments:segments.length};
    ringIndexCache16318.set(ring,meta);
    ringIndexStats16318.ringsBuilt++;
    ringIndexStats16318.segmentsIndexed+=segments.length;
    return meta;
  }
  function edgeContains(p,a,b){
    const x=Number(p[0]),y=Number(p[1]),x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
    const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(len<1e-20)return Math.hypot(x-x1,y-y1)<1e-10;
    const cross=(x-x1)*dy-(y-y1)*dx;if(Math.abs(cross)>1e-10)return false;
    const dot=(x-x1)*dx+(y-y1)*dy;if(dot<0)return false;return dot<=len;
  }
  function inRing(point,ring){
    if(!finitePoint(point)||!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return false;
    const meta=ringIndex16318(ring);if(!meta)return false;
    let inside=false;const x=Number(point[0]),y=Number(point[1]);
    ringIndexStats16318.pointTests++;
    if(x<meta.minX||x>meta.maxX||y<meta.minY||y>meta.maxY)return false;

      const a=seg.a,b=seg.b;if(edgeContains(point,a,b))return true;

      const hit=((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-15)+xi);if(hit)inside=!inside;
    }
    return inside;
  }
  function inPolygon(point,rings){
    if(!Array.isArray(rings)||!rings.length||!inRing(point,rings[0]))return false;
    for(let i=1;i<rings.length;i++)if(inRing(point,rings[i]))return false;
    return true;
  }
  function inGeometry(point,geometry){
    if(!geometry)return false;
    if(geometry.type==='Polygon')return inPolygon(point,geometry.coordinates||[]);
    if(geometry.type==='MultiPolygon')return (geometry.coordinates||[]).some(poly=>inPolygon(point,poly));
    return false;
  }

  function finitePoint(p){return Array.isArray(p)&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[0]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[1]));}
  /* EARTHLINE 16318 — exact point-in-ring acceleration. The original crossing
     predicate is preserved byte-for-byte below; this index only eliminates ring
     segments whose latitude range cannot possibly participate in the test. */
  const ringIndexCache16318=new WeakMap();
  const ringIndexStats16318={ringsBuilt:0,segmentsIndexed:0,pointTests:0,candidateSegments:0};
  function ringIndex16318(ring){
    if(!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return null;
    const cached=ringIndexCache16318.get(ring);if(cached)return cached;
    let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;
    const segments=[];
    for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
      const a=ring[j],b=ring[i];if(!finitePoint(a)||!finitePoint(b))continue;
      const x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
      minX=Math.min(minX,x1,x2);maxX=Math.max(maxX,x1,x2);
      minY=Math.min(minY,y1,y2);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y1,y2);
      segments.push({a,b,ymin:Math.min(y1,y2),ymax:Math.max(y1,y2)});
    }
    if(!segments.length)return null;
    const bucketCount=Math.max(32,Math.min(512,Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(segments.length)*2)));
    const span=Math.max(1e-12,maxY-minY),buckets=Array.from({length:bucketCount},()=>[]);
    const bucketFor=y=>Math.max(0,Math.min(bucketCount-1,Math.floor(((Number(y)-minY)/span)*bucketCount)));
    for(const seg of segments){
      const lo=bucketFor(seg.ymin),hi=bucketFor(seg.ymax);
      for(let k=lo;k<=hi;k++)buckets[k].push(seg);
    }
    const meta={minX,minY,maxX,maxY,span,bucketCount,buckets,bucketFor,segments:segments.length};
    ringIndexCache16318.set(ring,meta);
    ringIndexStats16318.ringsBuilt++;
    ringIndexStats16318.segmentsIndexed+=segments.length;
    return meta;
  }
  function edgeContains(p,a,b){
    const x=Number(p[0]),y=Number(p[1]),x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
    const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(len<1e-20)return Math.hypot(x-x1,y-y1)<1e-10;
    const cross=(x-x1)*dy-(y-y1)*dx;if(Math.abs(cross)>1e-10)return false;
    const dot=(x-x1)*dx+(y-y1)*dy;if(dot<0)return false;return dot<=len;
  }
  function inRing(point,ring){
    if(!finitePoint(point)||!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return false;
    const meta=ringIndex16318(ring);if(!meta)return false;
    let inside=false;const x=Number(point[0]),y=Number(point[1]);
    ringIndexStats16318.pointTests++;
    if(x<meta.minX||x>meta.maxX||y<meta.minY||y>meta.maxY)return false;
    const candidates=meta.buckets[meta.bucketFor(y)]||[];
    ringIndexStats16318.candidateSegments+=candidates.length;
    for(const seg of candidates){
      const a=seg.a,b=seg.b;if(edgeContains(point,a,b))return true;
      const xi=Number(b[0]),yi=Number(b[1]),xj=Number(a[0]),yj=Number(a[1]);
      const hit=((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-15)+xi);if(hit)inside=!inside;
    }
    return inside;
  }
  function inPolygon(point,rings){
    if(!Array.isArray(rings)||!rings.length||!inRing(point,rings[0]))return false;
    for(let i=1;i<rings.length;i++)if(inRing(point,rings[i]))return false;
    return true;
  }
  function inGeometry(point,geometry){
    if(!geometry)return false;
    if(geometry.type==='Polygon')return inPolygon(point,geometry.coordinates||[]);
    if(geometry.type==='MultiPolygon')return (geometry.coordinates||[]).some(poly=>inPolygon(point,poly));
    return false;
  }

  const ringIndexCache16318=new WeakMap();

  function ringIndex16318(ring){

    const cached=ringIndexCache16318.get(ring);if(cached)return cached;
    let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;

      const a=ring[j],b=ring[i];if(!finitePoint(a)||!finitePoint(b))continue;
      const x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
      minX=Math.min(minX,x1,x2);maxX=Math.max(maxX,x1,x2);
      minY=Math.min(minY,y1,y2);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y1,y2);
      segments.push({a,b,ymin:Math.min(y1,y2),ymax:Math.max(y1,y2)});
    }
    if(!segments.length)return null;

    const bucketFor=y=>Math.max(0,Math.min(bucketCount-1,Math.floor(((Number(y)-minY)/span)*bucketCount)));

  function edgeContains(p,a,b){

    const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(len<1e-20)return Math.hypot(x-x1,y-y1)<1e-10;

    }

  function inPolygon(point,rings){

(function(){

  function finitePoint(p){return Array.isArray(p)&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[0]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[1]));}
  /* EARTHLINE 16318 — exact point-in-ring acceleration. The original crossing
     predicate is preserved byte-for-byte below; this index only eliminates ring
     segments whose latitude range cannot possibly participate in the test. */
  const ringIndexCache16318=new WeakMap();
  const ringIndexStats16318={ringsBuilt:0,segmentsIndexed:0,pointTests:0,candidateSegments:0};
  function ringIndex16318(ring){
    if(!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return null;
    const cached=ringIndexCache16318.get(ring);if(cached)return cached;
    let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;
    const segments=[];
    for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
      const a=ring[j],b=ring[i];if(!finitePoint(a)||!finitePoint(b))continue;
      const x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
      minX=Math.min(minX,x1,x2);maxX=Math.max(maxX,x1,x2);
      minY=Math.min(minY,y1,y2);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y1,y2);
      segments.push({a,b,ymin:Math.min(y1,y2),ymax:Math.max(y1,y2)});
    }
    if(!segments.length)return null;
    const bucketCount=Math.max(32,Math.min(512,Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(segments.length)*2)));
    const span=Math.max(1e-12,maxY-minY),buckets=Array.from({length:bucketCount},()=>[]);
    const bucketFor=y=>Math.max(0,Math.min(bucketCount-1,Math.floor(((Number(y)-minY)/span)*bucketCount)));
    for(const seg of segments){
      const lo=bucketFor(seg.ymin),hi=bucketFor(seg.ymax);
      for(let k=lo;k<=hi;k++)buckets[k].push(seg);
    }
    const meta={minX,minY,maxX,maxY,span,bucketCount,buckets,bucketFor,segments:segments.length};
    ringIndexCache16318.set(ring,meta);
    ringIndexStats16318.ringsBuilt++;
    ringIndexStats16318.segmentsIndexed+=segments.length;
    return meta;
  }
  function edgeContains(p,a,b){
    const x=Number(p[0]),y=Number(p[1]),x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
    const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(len<1e-20)return Math.hypot(x-x1,y-y1)<1e-10;
    const cross=(x-x1)*dy-(y-y1)*dx;if(Math.abs(cross)>1e-10)return false;
    const dot=(x-x1)*dx+(y-y1)*dy;if(dot<0)return false;return dot<=len;
  }
  function inRing(point,ring){
    if(!finitePoint(point)||!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return false;

    let inside=false;const x=Number(point[0]),y=Number(point[1]);

    }
    return inside;
  }
  function inPolygon(point,rings){
    if(!Array.isArray(rings)||!rings.length||!inRing(point,rings[0]))return false;
    for(let i=1;i<rings.length;i++)if(inRing(point,rings[i]))return false;
    return true;
  }
  function inGeometry(point,geometry){

    if(geometry.type==='Polygon')return inPolygon(point,geometry.coordinates||[]);
    if(geometry.type==='MultiPolygon')return (geometry.coordinates||[]).some(poly=>inPolygon(point,poly));
    return false;
  }

     official VCGI geometry once, instead of clipping every already-interior

<!-- EARTHLINE BUILD 16178 — OFFICIAL VERMONT BOUNDARY AND SEARCH-IDENTITY OWNER START -->
<script id="earthline-build-16178-state-identity-boundary-timeout">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const BUILD='EARTHLINE 16249';
  const SERVICE='https://maps.vcgi.vermont.gov/arcgis/rest/services/VCGI_services/VCGI_BASEMAP_WM_v2/MapServer/21/query';
  const CACHE_KEY='earthline.vcgi.state-boundary.v1';
  let boundaryPromise=null,boundaryGeometry=null,lastError=null;
  const clone=v=>v==null?v:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
  function finitePoint(p){return Array.isArray(p)&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[0]))&&Number.isFinite(Number(p[1]));}
  /* EARTHLINE 16318 — exact point-in-ring acceleration. The original crossing
     predicate is preserved byte-for-byte below; this index only eliminates ring
     segments whose latitude range cannot possibly participate in the test. */
  const ringIndexCache16318=new WeakMap();
  const ringIndexStats16318={ringsBuilt:0,segmentsIndexed:0,pointTests:0,candidateSegments:0};
  function ringIndex16318(ring){
    if(!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return null;
    const cached=ringIndexCache16318.get(ring);if(cached)return cached;
    let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;
    const segments=[];
    for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
      const a=ring[j],b=ring[i];if(!finitePoint(a)||!finitePoint(b))continue;
      const x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
      minX=Math.min(minX,x1,x2);maxX=Math.max(maxX,x1,x2);
      minY=Math.min(minY,y1,y2);maxY=Math.max(maxY,y1,y2);
      segments.push({a,b,ymin:Math.min(y1,y2),ymax:Math.max(y1,y2)});
    }
    if(!segments.length)return null;
    const bucketCount=Math.max(32,Math.min(512,Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(segments.length)*2)));
    const span=Math.max(1e-12,maxY-minY),buckets=Array.from({length:bucketCount},()=>[]);
    const bucketFor=y=>Math.max(0,Math.min(bucketCount-1,Math.floor(((Number(y)-minY)/span)*bucketCount)));
    for(const seg of segments){
      const lo=bucketFor(seg.ymin),hi=bucketFor(seg.ymax);
      for(let k=lo;k<=hi;k++)buckets[k].push(seg);
    }
    const meta={minX,minY,maxX,maxY,span,bucketCount,buckets,bucketFor,segments:segments.length};
    ringIndexCache16318.set(ring,meta);
    ringIndexStats16318.ringsBuilt++;
    ringIndexStats16318.segmentsIndexed+=segments.length;
    return meta;
  }
  function edgeContains(p,a,b){
    const x=Number(p[0]),y=Number(p[1]),x1=Number(a[0]),y1=Number(a[1]),x2=Number(b[0]),y2=Number(b[1]);
    const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(len<1e-20)return Math.hypot(x-x1,y-y1)<1e-10;
    const cross=(x-x1)*dy-(y-y1)*dx;if(Math.abs(cross)>1e-10)return false;
    const dot=(x-x1)*dx+(y-y1)*dy;if(dot<0)return false;return dot<=len;
  }
  function inRing(point,ring){
    if(!finitePoint(point)||!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return false;
    const meta=ringIndex16318(ring);if(!meta)return false;
    let inside=false;const x=Number(point[0]),y=Number(point[1]);
    ringIndexStats16318.pointTests++;
    if(x<meta.minX||x>meta.maxX||y<meta.minY||y>meta.maxY)return false;
    const candidates=meta.buckets[meta.bucketFor(y)]||[];
    ringIndexStats16318.candidateSegments+=candidates.length;
    for(const seg of candidates){
      const a=seg.a,b=seg.b;if(edgeContains(point,a,b))return true;
      const xi=Number(b[0]),yi=Number(b[1]),xj=Number(a[0]),yj=Number(a[1]);
      const hit=((yi>y)!==(yj>y))&&(x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-15)+xi);if(hit)inside=!inside;
    }
    return inside;
  }
  function inPolygon(point,rings){
    if(!Array.isArray(rings)||!rings.length||!inRing(point,rings[0]))return false;
    for(let i=1;i<rings.length;i++)if(inRing(point,rings[i]))return false;
    return true;
  }
  function inGeometry(point,geometry){
    if(!geometry)return false;
    if(geometry.type==='Polygon')return inPolygon(point,geometry.coordinates||[]);
    if(geometry.type==='MultiPolygon')return (geometry.coordinates||[]).some(poly=>inPolygon(point,poly));
    return false;
  }
  /* EARTHLINE 16317 — certify a complete analysis rectangle as interior to the
     official VCGI geometry once, instead of clipping every already-interior
     contour/flow/swale line against the state polygon. Any uncertainty falls
     back to the frozen exact clip path below. */
  const interiorCertificateCache16317=new Map();
  const exactClipRunCache16318=new Map();
  function pointInRect16317(p,b){
    return finitePoint(p)&&Array.isArray(b)&&b.length===4&&
      Number(p[0])>=Number(b[0])&&Number(p[0])<=Number(b[2])&&
      Number(p[1])>=Number(b[1])&&Number(p[1])<=Number(b[3]);
  }
  function orient16317(a,b,c){
    return (Number(b[0])-Number(a[0]))*(Number(c[1])-Number(a[1]))-
           (Number(b[1])-Number(a[1]))*(Number(c[0])-Number(a[0]));
  }
  function segmentsIntersect16317(a,b,c,d){
    const o1=orient16317(a,b,c),o2=orient16317(a,b,d),o3=orient16317(c,d,a),o4=orient16317(c,d,b),eps=1e-12;
    if(((o1>eps&&o2<-eps)||(o1<-eps&&o2>eps))&&((o3>eps&&o4<-eps)||(o3<-eps&&o4>eps)))return true;
    if(Math.abs(o1)<=eps&&edgeContains(c,a,b))return true;
    if(Math.abs(o2)<=eps&&edgeContains(d,a,b))return true;
    if(Math.abs(o3)<=eps&&edgeContains(a,c,d))return true;
    if(Math.abs(o4)<=eps&&edgeContains(b,c,d))return true;
    return false;
  }
  function geometryRings16317(g){
    if(!g)return [];
    if(g.type==='Polygon')return g.coordinates||[];

  const ringIndexCache16318=new WeakMap();

  function ringIndex16318(ring){
    if(!Array.isArray(ring)||ring.length<3)return null;
    const cached=ringIndexCache16318.get(ring);if(cached)return cached;
    let minX=Infinity,minY=Infinity,maxX=-Infinity,maxY=-Infinity;

  function edgeContains(p,a,b){

  }

  function inPolygon(point,rings){

  function deriveReasons(raw){
